title: Verify the change
description: What the current change can break and which tests show it; `--run` runs them in a sandbox.

title: Change impact
description: Importers, tests and co-changed files reachable from changed paths or a symbol.

title: Task context shortlist
description: Ranks the files most relevant to a task description.

title: Change passport
description: Pre-PR evidence packet: what the diff touches, linked tests, risks and blind spots.

title: Vet a skill or plugin before installing
description: Pins a GitHub URL (or reads a local directory) and statically inspects its skills and plugin components.

title: Audit installed skills, hooks and MCP servers
description: Everything Claude Code loads here, whoever installed it, with firewall findings and context cost.

title: Context budget
description: Always-loaded and per-prompt context repo-ai adds, against limits.

title: Python security lint on the change (ruff S rules)
description: Runs an approved local ruff with a curated set of flake8-bandit rules on the changed Python files and reports findings on added lines as SARIF.

title: Multi-language SAST (Semgrep CE)
description: Dataflow-aware static analysis with SARIF output for JS/TS, Go, Java, Python and more.
network: rule registry downloads unless local rules and --metrics=off

title: Vulnerable dependency audit
description: pip-audit, npm audit or osv-scanner against the lockfiles the change touches.

title: Precise references and rename (language server)
description: Claude Code's LSP tool through an official language-server plugin (pyright-lsp, typescript-lsp, gopls-lsp …).
network: none at runtime; installing the server binary is yours

title: Browser runtime evidence (Chrome DevTools MCP)
description: Console errors, network, performance traces and screenshots for front-end changes, from an isolated browser profile.
network: the pages you open; usage statistics are ON by default (use --no-usage-statistics --no-performance-crux)

title: Mutation testing
description: Measures whether the tests would catch a change (mutmut for Python, Stryker for JS/TS, mewt via Trail of Bits).

title: Property-based testing
description: Hypothesis or fast-check tests for invariants, round-trips and edge cases.

title: Differential security review workflow
description: Trail of Bits' structured security review of a diff (threat-model the change, then check each class).
